svg.title: SV-833 turbidity, bacteria, and phosphorus observations
svg.desc: Three aligned time panels show every original activity from 2021 through the captured 2026 observations. E. coli uses a logarithmic axis and arrows for above-quantitation values; phosphorus reporting intervals are retained.

g.text: One value per original activity · arrows indicate above-quantitation lower bounds
Vertical intervals preserve below-quantitation phosphorus · query window ends October 13, 2026
